newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's defence minister leaves for India.
newsitem.headline: Russia's defence minister leaves for India.

text.p: Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov on Monday left for India, where he is expected to sign a treaty on increased military cooperation, Russian news agencies reported.
They said Russian military sources did not exclude the possibility that Rodionov would discuss supplying India with military aircraft and other weapons.
"It has been made clear to us that India is ready to start a military and strategic partnership with Russia," a senior defence ministry source told Interfax news agency.
Itar-Tass news agency said India had confirmed its intention to buy 40 multi-purpose Sukhoi Su-30 jets for a total of $1.8 billion.

Rodionov would discuss how to solve the problem of maintaining Russian weapons and equipment which India had bought as well as whether Indian officers would be sent to Russian training establishments, Interfax said.
